description: Looks up a packaged food or drink in Open Food Facts (3M+ products) by barcode or by name and returns a 0-100 health score (Excellent / Good / Poor / Bad) with the reasons: nutrition (Nutri-Score), additives and their risk level, and how processed it is. For questions such as whether a product is healthy. A barcode gives the most precise match.

country.description: Optional country to prefer when searching by name, e.g. 'united-states', 'france', 'united-kingdom'.

query.description: Product name, ideally with the brand, e.g. 'Nutella hazelnut spread'. Used when there is no barcode.

name: check_food
title: Check a food product
